notes.content:

[list]

[*] fixed: in some rare cases the tutorial "throttle up" was not triggered correctly
[/list]
Thank you for the feedback!

notes.title: Update #4: v1.856
notes.content:
We are proud to announce the latest update and exiting Early Access with the following changes:
[list]
[*] missions game mode: 4 additional missions (single player & multiplayer)
[*] survival game mode: two survival levels (single player & multiplayer)
[*] custom game mode: two custom battle levels (single player & multiplayer)
[*] HTC Vive virtual reality headset support
[*] new networking lobby system
[*] handle up to 12 controllers / joysticks
[*] new laser sound
[*] improvements in visuals and performance
[*] bug fixes
[/list]
Thanks a lot for the community for the feedback! We know that not every wish or request was implemented but we've tried to address the most important issues. In some other cases we had to choose side. We are still open for bug reports and feature requests as if the game prospers on Steam we tend to continue adding features.

notes.title: Early Access launched!
notes.content:
We proudly present the Early Access version of Starway Fleet! You can test your pilot skills in 6 single player missions with your AI wingmen or even with one or two of your allies in co-op multiplayer mode. Keep in mind that there can be glitches and jitters but this is why we are in Early Access. Please let us know what you think by using our forums or emailing us to support@starwayfleet-game.com

Good luck fighters!

notes.title: Gameplay teaser video from the first mission
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rv_-9OYF0qY
We hope you will like our new video. It depicts parts of the first mission, entitled ‘Homebound’. This mission is about ten minutes long and it turned out to be quite eventful. The background story reveals that Starway Fleet has several battle groups. The game’s story is centered on one of them. The player takes the place of a fighter pilot serving in one of the fighter squadrons assigned to Task Force Stealth Panther.

We put great emphasis on radio chatter that can be heard during missions. You have the chance to hear some of it in this mission. Currently, all gameplay triggers function correctly, there are only a handful of special features left to do. We are also continuously tuning the game graphics, with special focus laid on the space ambience with lights, mist and other effects. Multiplayer is also worked on and progressing well.

We hope that you like this little gameplay teaser. Soon we will assemble a spoiler-free video mix about the upcoming missions. For the meantime, follow us and like. Spread the news that Starway Fleet counts on all pilots.

Web: http://starwayfleet-game.com/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/pg/starwayfleetgame/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/StarwayFleet/
